request.style: English, deep male baritone, solo with gospel choir, acoustic piano, upright bass, brushed drums, slide guitar, warm and contemplative, 75 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
I sought the Lord and he heard my cry
He answered me from the other side
Delivered me from all my fears
The weight of the world disappears

[Chorus]
Taste and see that the Lord is good
Blessed is the one who stands in his blood
Refuge found in the shelter of grace
No matter the price of time or space

[Verse]
Those who look to him shine with light
Their faces never see the night of shame
The poor man called and the Lord heard
He saved him from every trouble found

[Chorus]
Taste and see that the Lord is good
Blessed is the one who stands in his blood
Refuge found in the shelter of grace
No matter the price of time or space

[Bridge]
His angel encamps around the faithful
Rescuing the soul that has been shaken
Fear the Lord you holy ones
Lacking nothing under the sun

[Outro]
Young lions grow poor and hungry
But those who seek lack no good thing
